product_overview: DarsakAI is an education management platform for tutoring centers in Egypt, providing teachers with tools to manage students, grades, attendance, exams, and subscriptions across web and desktop clients. It also supports public marketing pages and app distribution/update flows.
core_goals: Enable secure teacher account registration and login with JWT-based authentication
Provide full CRUD management for students, groups, grades, attendance, invoices, lessons, and exams
Support subscription plan viewing, code activation, and payment request initiation
Deliver dashboard statistics for quick operational insights
Allow lesson video hosting and streaming through Telegram integration
Support web and desktop client access to the same backend services

features.name: Teacher Authentication
features.description: Allows teachers to register, log in, view their profile, and refresh tokens for continued access.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid email, full name, and password -> Receive 200 with teacher profile, teacher_code, and onboarding state -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with the same credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token and refresh_token -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with access token -> Receive 200 with current teacher profile
POST /api/v1/auth/register with invalid or missing fields -> Receive validation error response -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with incorrect password -> Receive authentication error response
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with a valid refresh_token -> Receive 200 with new access_token and refresh_token -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with new access token -> Receive 200 with profile data
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with expired or malformed refresh_token -> Receive error response and no new tokens issued

features.name: Student Management
features.description: Lets authenticated teachers create, list, view, update, and delete their student records, including attendance and grade history access.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/students/ with full_name and optional code, parent_phone, group_id, and pin -> Receive 200 with created student object -> GET /api/v1/students/ -> Receive 200 with teacher student list -> GET /api/v1/students/{student_id} -> Receive 200 with the selected student record

POST /api/v1/students/ with missing or too-short full_name -> Receive validation error response -> GET /api/v1/students/{student_id} for a student not owned by the teacher -> Receive authorization or not-found error response
PUT /api/v1/students/{student_id} with updated full_name, group_id, or pin -> Receive 200 with updated student object -> DELETE /api/v1/students/{student_id} -> Receive 200 with deleted=true

GET /api/v1/students/count -> Receive 200 with total student count -> GET /api/v1/students/{student_id}/attendance -> Receive 200 with attendance records -> GET /api/v1/students/{student_id}/grades -> Receive 200 with grade records
GET /api/v1/students/{student_id}/attendance for an unknown student_id -> Receive error response -> GET /api/v1/students/{student_id}/grades for an unknown student_id -> Receive error response

features.name: Groups Management
features.description: Enables teachers to organize students into groups and manage group metadata such as subject, level, day, and time.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/groups/ with name and optional subject, level, day_of_week, and time_slot -> Receive 200 with created group object -> GET /api/v1/groups/ -> Receive 200 with teacher group list -> GET /api/v1/groups/{group_id} -> Receive 200 with group details
POST /api/v1/groups/ with empty name -> Receive validation error response -> GET /api/v1/groups/{group_id} for a group not owned by the teacher -> Receive authorization or not-found error response
PUT /api/v1/groups/{group_id} with updated subject or time_slot -> Receive 200 with updated group object -> DELETE /api/v1/groups/{group_id} -> Receive 200 with deleted=true

features.name: Attendance Management
features.description: Allows teachers to record attendance manually, by barcode, or in bulk, and to review attendance records and daily statistics.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/attendance/ with student_id, ISO date, and status present -> Receive 200 with created attendance record -> GET /api/v1/attendance/ with date filter -> Receive 200 with matching attendance records -> GET /api/v1/attendance/stats -> Receive 200 with present, absent, and late counts

POST /api/v1/attendance/barcode with a valid student barcode -> Receive 200 with attendance record for today marked present -> GET /api/v1/attendance/ with student_id filter -> Receive 200 with that student's attendance records

POST /api/v1/attendance/bulk with an array of attendance records -> Receive 200 with created records array -> GET /api/v1/attendance/ with student_id filter -> Receive 200 with filtered attendance list
POST /api/v1/attendance/barcode with an unknown barcode -> Receive error response and no attendance record created

features.name: Grades Management
features.description: Supports grade creation, listing, updating, and deletion for students, with filtering by subject or student.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/grades/ with student_id and score -> Receive 200 with created grade object -> GET /api/v1/grades/ with student_id filter -> Receive 200 with grade list -> PUT /api/v1/grades/{grade_id} with updated score or notes -> Receive 200 with updated grade object

POST /api/v1/grades/ with missing student_id or non-numeric score -> Receive validation error response -> DELETE /api/v1/grades/{grade_id} for a non-owned grade -> Receive authorization or not-found error response
GET /api/v1/grades/ with subject filter -> Receive 200 with filtered grades -> DELETE /api/v1/grades/{grade_id} -> Receive 200 with deleted=true

features.name: Invoices Management
features.description: Allows teachers to create and manage invoices for students and view invoice summary statistics.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/invoices/ with student_id and amount -> Receive 200 with created invoice object -> GET /api/v1/invoices/ with student_id filter -> Receive 200 with invoice list -> PUT /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id} with updated amount or status -> Receive 200 with updated invoice object

POST /api/v1/invoices/ with missing student_id or invalid amount -> Receive validation error response -> DELETE /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id} for a non-owned invoice -> Receive authorization or not-found error response
GET /api/v1/invoices/stats -> Receive 200 with invoice totals and paid/pending counts -> DELETE /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id} -> Receive 200 with deleted=true

features.name: Exams and Questions
features.description: Enables teachers to create exams, manage exam details, and add, update, or delete exam questions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/exams/ with title and optional duration_minutes and total_points -> Receive 200 with created exam object -> GET /api/v1/exams/ -> Receive 200 with exam list -> GET /api/v1/exams/{exam_id} -> Receive 200 with exam details
POST /api/v1/exams/ with missing title -> Receive validation error response -> GET /api/v1/exams/{exam_id} for a non-owned exam -> Receive authorization or not-found error response

POST /api/v1/exams/{exam_id}/questions with question_text and options -> Receive 200 with created question object -> PUT /api/v1/exams/questions/{question_id} with updated text or points -> Receive 200 with updated question object -> DELETE /api/v1/exams/questions/{question_id} -> Receive 200 with deleted=true

PUT /api/v1/exams/questions/{question_id} for a question linked to another teacher's exam -> Receive 200 or error depending on question existence, with ownership validation gap noted in backend behavior

features.name: Lessons and Video Hosting
features.description: Supports lesson creation, publishing, and Telegram-based lesson video upload with streaming URL retrieval.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/lessons/ with title and optional group_id or subject -> Receive 200 with created lesson object -> POST /api/v1/lessons/{lesson_id}/upload-video with a valid file -> Receive 200 with Telegram file_id, message_id, and duration -> GET /api/v1/lessons/{lesson_id}/stream-url -> Receive 200 with stream_url

POST /api/v1/lessons/ with missing title -> Receive validation error response -> POST /api/v1/lessons/{lesson_id}/upload-video with oversized or invalid file -> Receive error response and no video uploaded
GET /api/v1/lessons/ with is_published filter -> Receive 200 with paginated lessons result -> PUT /api/v1/lessons/{lesson_id} with is_published=true -> Receive 200 with updated lesson object

POST /api/v1/lessons/setup-channel -> Receive 200 with Telegram channel_id and title -> GET /api/v1/lessons/{lesson_id}/stream-url for a lesson without uploaded video -> Receive error response or missing stream URL

features.name: Subscription Management
features.description: Lets teachers view available plans, activate subscription codes, inspect current subscription status, and request manual payment processing.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/subscriptions/plans -> Receive 200 with active plan list -> GET /api/v1/subscriptions/my -> Receive 200 with current subscription and plan data -> POST /api/v1/subscriptions/activate with a valid code -> Receive 200 with subscription object and plan object
POST /api/v1/subscriptions/activate with an invalid or already-used code -> Receive error response and no subscription created
POST /api/v1/subscriptions/payment-request with plan_id, phone_number, and amount -> Receive 200 with payment request object -> GET /api/v1/subscriptions/my -> Receive 200 showing subscription status
POST /api/v1/subscriptions/payment-request with missing plan_id or invalid amount -> Receive validation error response

features.name: Dashboard Statistics
features.description: Provides aggregated operational counts for the authenticated teacher to support dashboard views.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/dashboard/stats -> Receive 200 with students, groups, today_attendance, pending_invoices, and active_exams counts
GET /api/v1/dashboard/stats without a valid access token -> Receive authentication error response

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Exposes a public health endpoint for uptime monitoring and deployment verification.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with status healthy
GET /health during normal operation failures at downstream services -> Receive 200 with healthy status if the application process is running, or a server error if the app cannot start
